title: _work
description: A unit of work. It is created by a person or a skill and follows a _process; the engine creates its _task records from that process. It is approved or rejected as a whole. Draft v0.

type.description: The kind of work, such as "code" or "article": the id of the _process it follows.

status.description: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS or DONE. Set by the engine from its tasks.

assignee.description: A role, not an agent. Set when the approval is given to a bot role.

rejectedAt.description: A rejected work stays rejected: it is final.

previous.description: Another work that this work follows, so that the history stays linked: a rejected work that this one redoes, or a finished work that this one continues. It is not limited to the rejection flow, and it is optional: null for a work that follows none. The engine never creates a work by itself: a person or a skill does, and the work it points to stays as it is.

recoveries.description: How many times the recovery of the MCP server leader has touched this work to start its approval again. It is 1 at most: a work that was already recovered once is left for a person.

canApprovedBy.description: The roles allowed to approve or reject it. Set by whoever creates the work. ["human"] when omitted, so no agent approves by default.

customInstructions.description: Overrides of the default instructions of the process, as { step name: text }. Set when the work is created.
